meta_description: LS Garden Services Southampton. Professional garden maintenance, design, and landscaping. Local family business. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Local Southampton Gardener — Garden Design & Maintenance
hero_subhead: Professional garden design and maintenance across Southampton. From overgrown lawns to complete landscaping — we handle it all.
services_subhead: We handle everything from routine maintenance to full garden redesigns, helping Southampton homeowners enjoy beautiful outdoor spaces year-round.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular lawn cutting, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal upkeep. We keep your garden looking pristine without you lifting a finger.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden layouts tailored to your space and style. We create functional, beautiful gardens that add value to your home.

services.title: Lawn Care & Restoration
services.desc: Overgrown lawn? We handle scarification, aeration, seeding, and feeding to restore tired grass to lush green.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Work
services.desc: Professional trimming, shaping, and removal of trees and hedges. Safe handling of large growth using proper equipment and technique.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Build new patios, decking, and pathways that transform how you use your garden. Durable materials, expert construction.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidying
services.desc: Full garden overhauls for cluttered or neglected spaces. We clear, dispose responsibly, and leave your garden ready for whatever's next.

about_pullquote: Good gardening is about listening to what your space needs and delivering real results.
about_para_1: LS Garden Services has been transforming Southampton gardens for over 15 years. Started as a solo operation, we've grown into a trusted local team handling everything from routine maintenance to ambitious landscaping projects. Our reputation is built on reliability, fair pricing, and genuine care for our customers' outdoor spaces.
about_para_2: We're Southampton residents too, which means we understand our local soil, climate, and seasonal challenges. Repeat customers make up most of our work — that tells you we show up on time, do what we promise, and leave your garden better than we found it. We work year-round and pride ourselves on honest advice and straightforward quotes with no hidden costs.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About LS Garden Services

reviews.text: Brilliant service. My garden was completely overgrown and I didn't know where to start. Lee came round, gave me a sensible plan, and got stuck in. Within a couple of weeks it looked amazing. Really professional and fair priced. Can't recommend highly enough.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had the lads in to do a full garden redesign last spring. They listened to what we wanted, drew up a proper plan, and the work was done on time and on budget. The patio is brilliant and the landscaping has really come together nicely. Will be using them again.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: I use Lee for regular maintenance every month and he's absolutely reliable. Always turns up when he says he will, gets the job done properly, and leaves everything tidy. Great bloke, doesn't mess about. Best gardener we've had round here.
reviews.author: David P.
